item.description: At 77, Houston grandmother Sistafabu Modupe still needs a day job. Her monthly Social Security check alone doesn't cover her bills, leaving her unable to retire. Like millions of older Americans facing financial hardship, she has come to terms with the possibility that she may have to work for the rest of her life.

item.description: Sydney and Mike Jensen thought they were on solid financial footing. Their cars were paid off, the mortgage was under control, and they both had full-time jobs. Then came a series of unexpected expenses and like so many families, their costs now exceed their earnings. They want their two young children to have less of a struggle in the future, but worry about what is happening with the cost of living.
